title: Fenris Set

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fenris Set is a Mountain-tier armor. This set is the tier above Root Set and Iron Armor and should be considered a "light armor" compared to Wolf Armor as its armor values are lower while having no movement speed penalty. It is currently the only armor in the game that provides a movement speed buff.

sections.heading: Armor pieces
sections.text:
This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Workbench.
* = set exclusive bonus

full_text:
Fenris Set

Introduction. Fenris Set is a Mountain-tier armor. This set is the tier above Root Set and Iron Armor and should be considered a "light armor" compared to Wolf Armor as its armor values are lower while having no movement speed penalty. It is currently the only armor in the game that provides a movement speed buff.

Armor pieces. This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Workbench.
* = set exclusive bonus

Notes. • Frost resist does not stack with Frost resistance mead, Yagluth power or other armor pieces.
• Frost resist will override the frost weakness from being Wet.
• Frost resist prevents Cold and Freezing effect.
• Fire resist does not stack with Fire resistance barley wine.
